facts.fact: The Gambia Press Union told the African Commission that the Access to Information Act, adopted in 2021, remains unimplemented, with public bodies yet to designate information officers.

GMB.note: No rules made or oversight body set up is stated; refused requests are reported without a decision.
The document states nothing on AI models, datasets or computing.
The document names no national cyber body, strategy, incident response or figures.

facts.fact: The Gambia Press Union cited the Cybercrime Bill 2023 as pending legislation with broad surveillance powers, heavy fines and prison terms.

The Gambia Press Union, in a statement to the African Commission's 87th session in Banjul, criticised the Cybercrime Bill 2023, the Communications Bill 2025 and the Criminal Offences Act 2025 as threats to media freedom.
The Gambia Press Union said criminal defamation and false publication online had previously been struck down by the Supreme Court, giving no date.

GMB.note: Arrests cited (May 2025 protest, March 2026 court incident) are not stated to be for what was said.
